Alternatively, tests/test_review_autofix_terminal_same_head_gate.py — update `_marker` helper (line 80) to include `base_ref` and `_run_parser` (line 113) to pass `GATE_BASE_REF` and `GATE_BASE_UPDATED_AT`.
  Evidence of absence: The LAST RUN DIFF does not touch `tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py` or `tests/test_review_autofix_terminal_same_head_gate.py`. The PR changed 11 files; neither of the two contract test files that exercise the marker matching logic received updates. The new test `test_resume_state_rejects_unbound_legacy_marker_even_with_new_mtime` in `tests/test_retarget_merged_base.py` correctly verifies the rejection, but the pre-existing tests that previously passed are not updated to match the new behavior. The CI run 37194816557 confirms this gap.
